comment: Shared overview vectors (OV-2..OV-4, OV-9) for sdks/rust/tests/workbook_format3.rs and sdks/python/tests/test_workbook_format3.py. Each warning case also gives the 1-based lines where the viewer renders an <ap-investigation> card (cards) and whether it can display the document at all (renders); html/routes/overview-vectors.deno.test.ts checks those, and the insert_in_paragraph lines, against the bundled viewer parser.

  created REAL NOT NULL
);
